content: {"reasoning":"Prior authorization is missing, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; an appeal also requires a denial first. The claim is otherwise valid and timely, so submitting it with the strong supporting documentation can obtain an initial determination and support medical necessity, although records do not replace authorization. Patient billing or write-off is premature before payer adjudication establishes liability.","action":"submit_with_records"}
